concerns.text: The power analysis claim (≥ 80 % power for Cohen’s d ≈ 0.3 at Bonferroni‑adjusted α) is stated without any supporting calculation, variance estimate, or justification of the effect size for each parameter. This makes it unclear whether N = 2 400 is truly sufficient, especially given multiple parameters and depth/bin comparisons.

The plan assumes the additivity of quantization‑induced error (Δ = E_quant − E_inst) without explicitly scheduling the FR‑015 sensitivity analysis that validates this assumption. Without that validation, the causal claim that quantization dominates when Δ exceeds 10 % of instrumental error is unsound.

Waveform parameters are drawn on a “fixed grid per SNR bin,” but the plan does not ensure that the same intrinsic parameters (mass, spin, distance) are used across all bit‑depths within a bin. Variation in these parameters could confound the observed Δ, making it unclear whether differences are due to quantization or underlying signal properties.

Bonferroni correction is applied across six bit depths and four SNR bins, but the analysis involves three separate physical parameters (chirp mass, spin, distance). The plan does not account for this additional multiplicity, risking inflated family‑wise error rates.
